kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحملت (form VII)
# اِنْحَمَلْتُ (inḥamaltu) /in.ħa.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# اِنْحَمَلْتَ (inḥamalta) /in.ħa.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# اِنْحَمَلْتِ (inḥamalti) /in.ħa.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# اِنْحَمَلَتْ (inḥamalat) /in.ħa.ma.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
